blurb: eNRG Kayaking offers guided and self-guided paddling tours and rentals on local rivers and flatwater near Portland, Oregon, including the Willamette River and whitewater rivers. They also offer an all-inclusive 6-night whitewater rafting and kayaking adventure in Costa Rica on the Rio Pacuare. Rentals include kayaks, canoes, paddleboards, rafts, and gear with options for instruction and shuttle services.
